release_notes:
X-Finder Pro v2.5.1 Suite Update:
- Interactive Custom Payload Generator: Racik payload HTTP Custom/NetMod/OpenTunnel lengkap (Normal, Split, Direct, Rotate, Request Methods, Front/Back Query, Extra Headers, Tricks).
- SSL Certificate & SAN Extractor: Ekstrak sertifikat SSL & daftar Subject Alternative Names (SAN) untuk menemukan bug host tersembunyi.
- Custom Port Range Scanner: Pindai port tunnel, proxy, dan custom range 1-65535 secara multi-threaded.
- HTTP Header & CDN Fingerprint: Deteksi otomatis provider CDN/WAF (Cloudflare, Akamai, Fastly, AWS) dan Web Server.
- Reverse IP Multi-Source Engine: Google DoH PTR, AlienVault OTX, HackerTarget, RapidDNS.
- SSH WebSocket Account Edit & Delete Safety Validation.
